extracted.name: Pomegranate Molasses Dressing
extracted.description: A beautiful Middle Eastern dressing, it tastes like a more exotic version of Balsamic Vinaigrette! it's tangy and sweet with a hint of pomegranate fruitiness. Keeps for 3 weeks+.
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp Dijon mustard ((or English mustard, not hot))
instruction_lines: Place all ingredients in a jar and shake well. Adjust salt and pepper to taste.
Store for 3+ weeks in the fridge in an airtight container.
